newsitem.title: USA: America West reduces summer air fares.
newsitem.headline: America West reduces summer air fares.

text.p: America West Airlines said Friday that it has reduced fares to markets around the country for travel June 21 through October 1.

The company said reduced fare tickets can be purchased through June 16. Tickets, said the company, must be bought within 72 hours of making reservations and are non-refundable. Minimum stay and other restrictions apply.
One-way fares range from $119 to $199, based on round-trip purchases.
America West Airlines is a wholly owned subsidiary of America West Holdings Corp, an aviation and travel services company with annual sales of more than $1.7 billion.
